caseName: Johnson v. Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.
caseNameFull: Johnson v. Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.

opinions.text:
Appeal from Ct. App. Cal., 2d App. D’ist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating'the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
